prompt: which cities should I visit in japan on a 30 day trip? I'm into history, culture, food, fashion/design, nightlife/clubbing
response: On a 30-day trip, you should focus on Tokyo for its history, culture, food, fashion, and nightlife. Kyoto is also recommended for its historical sites and traditional culture. You can skip Osaka and Fukuoka as they don't offer much beyond what Tokyo and Kyoto provide. This will allow you to fully immerse yourself in the aspects you're interested in without feeling rushed.
